ac_text: [REVIEW] The arcs matrix reads clearly in light and dark mode
guidance: Matrix mostly works (20 labelled dots, tooltips, hover emphasis, click navigates; quadrant/guide text ≥5.5:1 both themes). Needed: (1) dark-mode .am-dot stroke/.am-name fill use a lighter accent — currently #5a6b3a on #1c1c16 = 2.93:1 (<4.5:1); (2) make coincident/near-coincident dots clickable — arc-005 is covered by arc-006 (2.7px) and arc-010 sits exactly under arc-001 (same value/cost), both fail hit-test; jitter/offset or a cluster affordance; (3) cost=4.5 cluster labels are nudged without leader lines so arc-001/arc-004 labels sit 16px off their dots — add leaders or align; (4) minor: arc-014/arc-005 labels sit on the median guide line.
